title: Paul Finch
body: Paul is programme director of the World Architecture Festival and editorial director of the Architectural Review and Architects’ Journal. He has more than 40 years’ experience as a journalist, working for Estates Times (deputy editor, 1976-83), Building Design (editor, 1983-94) Architects’ Journal (editor, 1994-99), Architectural Review (editor, 2005-09), and Planning in London (joint editor since 1994).
subtitle: Architectural critic
